investigation_notes.Script Purpose: Enumerates default domain password policy and fine-grained password policies and outputs JSON.
investigation_notes.Description: The script enumerates Active Directory default domain password policy and fine-grained password policies, collecting policy attributes and returning them as JSON. Key observations: it executed as SYSTEM on a domain controller, uses standard Get-AD* cmdlets (no obfuscation), and contains only benign data collection logic with no external network indicators in the evidence. Given the host context, account used, and clear administrative cmdlet usage consistent with AD inventory tasks, this activity is assessed as Low Priority (LP).
